items.text: Bears expected to start Case Keenum at QB vs Eagles MNF; Caleb Williams already ruled out (hamstring, 3-4 weeks Grade 2 prior).
items.why: Williams ruled out; Bagent cleared concussion but only one practice, Keenum slated.
items.implication: Major downgrade to Bears pass catchers (Moore, Odunze, Loveland, Burden); run-heavy likely.
items.opportunity: RB upgrade potential (Swift etc); fade WRs/TE vs Eagles D.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson ruled out with ankle injury after exiting early vs Bucs.
items.why: Ankle injury in first half; unable to return, ruled out early third quarter.
items.implication: Jordan Addison saw massive target/route spike (9 targets, 20 FP); monitor severity for ROS.
items.opportunity: Addison primary beneficiary on routes/targets/red-zone in Jefferson absence.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans carted off and ruled out with rib strain/injury vs Cardinals; full eval Monday.
items.why: Rib injury second quarter, carted; Rapoport confirms strain, painful, eval pending.
items.implication: Painful injury type often multi-week; reverse pre-game expected-to-play.
items.opportunity: Other 49ers WRs/TE elevated targets/routes in his absence.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh/quad injury vs Lions; exited fourth quarter.
items.why: Thigh injury late; MRI likely Monday per reports.
items.implication: Braelon Allen or committee elevated; check severity for next week.
items.opportunity: Backup RB snap/carry share expansion; Jets offense already thin at WR.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs Chiefs with knee injury; coach Jeff Hafley says 'does not sound optimistic' on major concern.
items.why: Non-contact knee injury early; further testing pending, early indications poor per coach and Rapoport.
items.implication: Extended absence possible; immediate handcuff/waiver priority on backups.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity shift; monitor Ollie Gordon or others for elevated carries/targets.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active vs Cowboys after positive pregame workout; expected limited (20-30 snaps). Previously GTD with team not counting on him.
items.why: Positive 20-min workout on hamstring convinced team; Rapoport notes likely limited usage.
items.implication: Start over Bateman if rostered; reverse any Bateman/Andrews beneficiaries from OUT assumption.
items.opportunity: Limited snaps but primary target for Lamar when on field; high-scoring game setup.

items.text: Cash review: Jahmyr Gibbs absolute must at $8800 (proj 27.7/44.4 ceil home vs Jets); Kenneth Walker second-best salary-adj (role elite vs Dolphins); Garrett Wilson strong setup missing 3 pass-catchers.
items.why: Absurd role/talent/matchup for Gibbs/Walker; Wilson target vacuum + dome/bad secondary. Won 73.9% H2H DK.
items.implication: Core cash pieces; force into lineups despite salary. Strong season start for Levitan cash.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Achane (knee), Jefferson (ankle), Hall (quad), Etienne (hamstring), Evans (rib), Mayfield (thumb)/McMillan (knee), Coker (quad), Andrews (hand), Spears (ankle), Bech (broken forearm IR).
items.why: Comprehensive post-slate list aligning Schefter/Rapoport; Bech to IR.
items.implication: Multiple high-impact OUT for ROS/waivers; reverse pregame expected (e.g. Evans).
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries across teams (Addison, Gordon, Allen, etc); handcuffs priority.

items.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield dislocated right thumb, MRI Monday; coach indicates likely miss time. Jalen McMillan also out knee.
items.why: Dislocated on INT play late; Rapoport confirms MRI and miss time expected.
items.implication: Backup QB (Daniels?) starts next; Bucs pass game downgrade, RBs/ WRs affected.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup QB streaming; elevated RB usage possible.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua inactive for SNF vs Broncos (along with Marvin Mims).
items.implication: Davante Adams/Kyren full opportunity; monitor return timeline.
items.opportunity: Adams target monopoly; other Rams WRs elevated.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers active and making 2026 season debut vs Saints after knee Q.
items.why: Cleared after limited practices; ETR/Levitan projected in.
items.implication: Immediate TE1 usage expected; strong fantasy debut potential.
items.opportunity: High target share TE role from snap one; red-zone/ dual-threat upside.

items.text: Zay Flowers active: risky but if active for Ravens he's active for me; start him over Bateman.
items.why: Despite hamstring risk/limited, prefers over Bateman in lineup.
items.implication: Start Flowers; fade or sit Bateman relative.
items.opportunity: Primary WR role even limited; Lamar connection.
items.conflict: Levitan initial OUT proj (late swap Bateman/Andrews).

items.text: With AD Mitchell expected inactive (finger), Jets WR depth: 1. Garrett Wilson 2. Isaiah Williams etc; expecting TE Kenyon Sadiq hybrid slot/wide. High opportunity for Wilson.
items.why: Mitchell (12 targets prior) out; Wilson projects 30%+ targets vs bad Lions secondary in dome.
items.implication: Must-start WR; cash lineup cornerstone at $6300 DK.
items.opportunity: Elevated target/route share, third-down/two-minute; Sadiq hybrid adds competition but Wilson clear #1.

items.text: Commanders expected to sign FA RB Austin Ekeler to 53-man pending physical; healed Achilles, worked out for Panthers last week, reunion.
items.why: Sources confirm pending physical; familiar landing spot post-Achilles recovery.
items.implication: Depth/pass-catching RB addition; potential committee or third-down role behind current backs.
items.opportunity: Handcuff or flex upside if volume; monitor depth chart comments.
